violation_title: Unitemized UB-04 Revenue Code Roll-Up (Missing Specific HCPCS/NDC Code)
cms_citation: CMS Claims Processing Manual Ch. 25 § 75.4 (Form CMS-1450 / UB-04) & 45 CFR § 164.524
violation_reason: Unitemized UB-04 Revenue Code Roll-Up (Missing Specific HCPCS/NDC Code): Hospital billed generic 4-digit Revenue Code 0250 (Pharmacy Services) without disclosing required 5-digit HCPCS J-codes or 11-digit National Drug Codes (NDC) and unit dosages. Unsupported roll-up markup above baseline dispensing fee ($24.00) is disallowed pending itemized pharmacy ledger.

violation_title: Unitemized UB-04 Revenue Code Roll-Up (Missing Specific HCPCS/NDC Code)
cms_citation: CMS Claims Processing Manual Ch. 25 § 75.4 (Form CMS-1450 / UB-04) & CMS OPPS Packaging Rule
violation_reason: Unitemized UB-04 Revenue Code Roll-Up (Missing Specific HCPCS/NDC Code): Hospital billed generic 4-digit Revenue Code 0260 (IV Therapy) without required 5-digit CPT infusion code (e.g. 96360/96365) or infusate HCPCS code. Unsupported roll-up markup above Medicare IV hydration baseline ($36.20) is disallowed.

violation_title: Unitemized UB-04 Revenue Code Roll-Up (Missing Specific HCPCS/NDC Code)
cms_citation: CMS Claims Processing Manual Ch. 25 § 75.4 & 42 CFR § 419.2(b) Packaged Supplies
violation_reason: Unitemized UB-04 Revenue Code Roll-Up (Missing Specific HCPCS/NDC Code): Hospital billed generic 4-digit Revenue Code 0270 (Medical/Surgical Supplies) as a bulk roll-up without a billable 5-digit HCPCS Level II implant/supply code. Routine supplies are packaged into facility fees; unsupported roll-up markup removed.
